## Design Context

Kidoo is an artwork-led Fire TV experience for primary-school children, with parents curating content and profiles. It should feel friendly, confident, and playful without being babyish. Use familiar YouTube and Netflix browsing cues, Kidoo's logo, a warm off-white child palette and calm dark-blue grown-up areas, large readable titles, and unmistakable remote focus. Separate movies, series, YouTube and family videos; show a series as one choice before revealing its episodes. Keep parent tools secondary, remote navigation predictable, and preserve approvals and per-profile viewing progress.

## Privacy

This repository is public. Never commit real family or child names, profile or viewing data, private network addresses, personal home paths, credentials, session tokens, private keys, logs, backups, or family media. Use generic examples and review changes, file metadata, and commit author information before publishing. Use a GitHub noreply address for commits. Ignore rules are a safeguard, not a substitute for review.

Use visual differences to orient families; always enforce parent access on the server, not by colour or hiding controls.
